text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. It also helps to break the project into milestones. These are important checkpoints that show your progress along the way. Another key element is deliverables—the actual products or results you promise to complete. Finally, you must ensure stakeholder alignment. This means everyone involved, from your team to your clients, agrees on the goals from the start. When all these pieces are in place, your project has a much better chance of succeeding.
